Abstract: Large language model agents are increasingly envisioned as always-on personal assistants with access to anything relevant in the user's digital world. Yet current systems operate over only narrow slices of that world, limiting context-sensitive reasoning and effective assistance. Existing benchmarks similarly provide only partial user state and therefore fail to capture performance in such a broad, always-on setting. To address this gap, we introduce Claw-Anything, a benchmark that expands agent context along three dimensions: long-horizon activity histories, interdependent backend services, and integrated GUI and CLI interaction across multiple devices. To instantiate this setting, we simulate months of user activity through multi-round event injection, producing complex world states and realistic noise, including irrelevant events and conflicting signals. Agents must reason over rich contextual environments while remaining robust to such noise. This expanded scope also enables the evaluation of proactive assistance, requiring agents to anticipate user needs and deliver timely recommendations. Experiments show that GPT-5.5 achieves only 34.5% pass@1, substantially below prior benchmarks, underscoring a gap between current agent capabilities and the demands of always-on personal assistance. Alongside the benchmark, we release an automated data-generation pipeline that yields 2,000 training environments and improves the base model by 23.7%, demonstrating its utility of scalable data infrastructure.

</details>


### [418] [From Model Scaling to System Scaling: Scaling the Harness in Agentic AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26112)
*Shangding Gu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出智能体AI的下一个瓶颈在于系统扩展（即"harness scaling"），而不仅仅是模型扩展。作者定义了"智能体 harness"概念，涵盖记忆、上下文构建、技能路由、编排循环和验证治理等组件，并指出了上下文治理、可信记忆和动态技能路由三大核心瓶颈，开发了开源参考实现CheetahClaws。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前对智能体AI的评估过于模型中心化，将记忆、检索、工具使用、编排和治理等视为次要实现细节，但这种视角日益不足，因为智能体性能实质上源于模型与这些组件的交互。作者主张应将这些系统组件作为一等设计对象来对待。

Method: 定义了"agent harness"概念（包括基础模型、记忆基底、上下文构造器、技能路由层、编排循环和验证治理层），识别了三大核心瓶颈：上下文治理、可信记忆和动态技能路由，并开发了Python原生参考实现CheetahClaws与其他系统进行比较。

Result: 开发了CheetahClaws开源参考实现，并与Claude Code和OpenClaw进行了对比。提出了超越一次性任务成功率的harness级基准研究议程，包括轨迹质量、记忆卫生、上下文效率、通信保真度、验证成本和随时间的安全演化等指标。

Conclusion: 未来智能体AI的进展将同样依赖于系统设计（harness scaling）和更强的基础模型。评估应转向更全面的harness级指标，而非仅关注最终任务成功率。

Abstract: This paper studies the next major bottleneck in agentic AI as system scaling, not only model scaling: the design of auditable, persistent, modular, and verifiable architectures around foundation models. We refer to this shift as scaling the harness: treating the structured execution layer around a foundation model as a first-class object of design, evaluation, and optimization. Although recent large language models enable agents to use tools, retrieve information, maintain memory, and execute long-horizon workflows, evaluation remains largely model-centric, often reducing agents to final-task success while treating memory, retrieval, tool use, orchestration, verification, and governance as secondary implementation details. This framing is increasingly inadequate because agent performance emerges from the interaction among the foundation model, memory substrate, context constructor, skill-routing layer, orchestration loop, and verification-and-governance layer. Together, these components form the agent harness, which translates model capability into long-horizon agent behavior. We study scaling the harness through three core bottlenecks: context governance, trustworthy memory, and dynamic skill routing, together with the orchestration and governance mechanisms that coordinate and constrain them. We further outline a research agenda for harness-level benchmarks that go beyond one-shot task success to measure trajectory quality, memory hygiene, context efficiency, communication fidelity, verification cost, and safe evolution over time. To make the discussion concrete, we develop CheetahClaws: https://github.com/SafeRL-Lab/cheetahclaws, a Python-native reference harness, and compare it with Claude Code and OpenClaw. Our main claim is that future progress in agentic AI will depend as much on system design as on stronger foundation models.

</details>


### [419] [MobileGym: A Verifiable and Highly Parallel Simulation Platform for Mobile GUI Agent Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26114)
*Dingbang Wu,Rui Hao,Haiyang Wang,Shuzhe Wu,Han Xiao,Zhenghong Li,Bojiang Zhou,Zheng Ju,Zichen Liu,Lue Fan,Zhaoxiang Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MobileGym是一个轻量级、可完全控制的浏览器端移动端环境，通过结构化JSON状态实现可验证结果信号和低成本在线强化学习，支持数百个并行实例运行。配备MobileGym-Bench基准（416个参数化任务模板），通过Sim-to-Real实验验证了其在模拟和真实设备上的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有移动端环境要么依赖专有后端难以扩展，要么缺乏可验证的结果信号和可扩展的在线强化学习能力。作者希望构建一个轻量级、可完全控制的环境，支持确定性状态判断和低成本并行在线强化学习，以推动日常移动应用的交互保真度研究。

Method: 1) 将完整环境状态捕获为结构化JSON，支持配置、分叉和比较；2) 单服务器可承载数百个并行实例（约400MB/实例，冷启动约3秒）；3) 分层状态模型+声明式任务定义框架，保持可编程性和可扩展性；4) 单一程序化判断机制输出确定性评估和密集RL奖励；5) 提供416个参数化任务模板（256测试+160训练），覆盖28个应用。

Result: 在Sim-to-Real案例研究中，GRPO在Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct上提升+12.8个百分点（256任务测试集）；在59个真实设备信号子集上，真实设备执行保留了模拟侧训练收益的95.1%。

Conclusion: MobileGym通过轻量级浏览器端设计和结构化JSON状态管理，成功实现了移动端环境的高保真交互、可验证结果信号和可扩展在线强化学习，Sim-to-Real实验证明模拟训练收益可有效迁移至真实设备。

Abstract: We present MobileGym, a browser-hosted, lightweight, fully controllable environment for everyday mobile use, targeting interaction fidelity without replicating proprietary backends. It enables two capabilities previously out of reach for everyday apps: verifiable outcome signals through deterministic state-based judging over structured JSON state, and scalable online RL through low-cost parallel rollouts. The full environment state is captured, configured, forked, and compared as structured JSON, and a single server can host hundreds of parallel instances, with about 400 MB memory per instance and about 3 s cold start. A layered state model and a declarative task-definition framework keep state programmability and task creation practical at scale, and a single programmatic judging mechanism delivers both deterministic evaluation verdicts and dense RL rewards. The accompanying MobileGym-Bench provides 416 parameterized task templates, including 256 test and 160 train templates, over 28 apps, with deterministic judges and a structured AnswerSheet protocol that avoids free-text matching failures. In a Sim-to-Real case study, GRPO on Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct gains +12.8 percentage points on the 256-task test set, and on a 59-task real-device signal subset, real-device execution retains 95.1% of the simulation-side training gain. Project page: https://mobilegym.github.io.

</details>


<div id='eess.IV'></div>

# eess.IV [[Back]](#toc)

### [420] [Methodology for Creating a Clinically Verified Dermoscopic Image Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25168)
*Kozachok Elena Sergeevna*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一套构建移动皮肤镜图像临床验证数据集的方法论，包含标准化采集流程、16字段信息模型和多阶段专家验证机制，最终构建了包含1,026张图像、9个疾病类别的数据集，所有恶性病变均经组织学确认。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有国际皮肤镜数据集大多在不同于俄罗斯常规门诊和移动皮肤镜实践的条件下创建，自动化诊断系统的性能不仅依赖图像数量，还依赖采集流程的可重复性、元数据的完整性和诊断标签的可靠性，但当前缺乏符合临床实践要求的标准数据集。

Method: 方法论包含三个组件：(1) 移动皮肤镜图像采集标准操作程序（SOP）；(2) 16个结构化元数据字段的信息模型，按ISIC兼容符号组织为6个临床模块；(3) 多阶段专家诊断标签验证：初始临床标注→三位专家共识评审→所有恶性病变的组织学确认。

Result: 2025年6月至2026年5月收集443例患者的1,026张独特皮肤镜图像（排除18个重复），涵盖9个疾病类别，39个恶性病变（18例黑色素瘤、15例基底细胞癌、6例鳞状细胞癌）均经组织学验证。患者年龄2-90岁（中位38岁），女性63%（279人），男性37%（164人）。每张图像配有专家标注的皮肤镜结构和验证阶段字段。

Conclusion: 该数据集作为试点临床验证资源，适用于独立模型评估、领域偏移分析、可解释性研究及进一步扩展。

Abstract: This study presents a methodology for constructing a clinically verified dataset of dermatoscopic images for medical informatics research. The relevance of the work is driven by the fact that the performance of automated diagnostic support systems depends not only on the volume of images, but also on the reproducibility of the image acquisition procedure, the completeness of structured metadata, and the reliability of diagnostic labels. International collections were primarily created under conditions that differ substantially from routine Russian outpatient practice and mobile dermatoscopy. The proposed methodology integrates three interconnected components: (1) a standard operating procedure (SOP) for acquiring images via mobile dermatoscopy, (2) an information model comprising 16 structured metadata fields organized into six clinically oriented blocks in ISIC-compatible notation, and (3) a multi-stage expert verification of diagnostic labels (initial clinical annotation, consensus review by three specialists, and histological confirmation of all malignant neoplasms). Using this methodology, a dataset of 1,026 unique dermatoscopic images from 443 patients was collected between June 2025 and May 2026. From 1,044 initial records, 18 duplicates were excluded. The dataset includes nine nosological categories; all 39 malignant lesions (18 melanomas, 15 basal cell carcinomas, and 6 squamous cell carcinomas) were histologically verified. Patient age ranged from 2 to 90 years (median 38), with 279 females (63%) and 164 males (37%). Each image is accompanied by expert-annotated dermatoscopic structures and an explicit verification_stage field indicating the level of diagnostic confirmation. The resulting dataset serves as a pilot clinically verified resource suitable for independent model evaluation, domain shift analysis, interpretability studies, and further expansion.

</details>


<div id='cs.RO'></div>

# cs.RO [[Back]](#toc)

### [421] [RED: Adaptive Real-Time DAG Scheduling for Robotic Inference under Environmental Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24044)
*Zexin Li,Tao Ren,Johnathan Liu,Xiaoxi He,Cong Liu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: RED是一个针对资源受限机器人平台上多任务深度神经网络工作负载的实时调度框架，通过截止时间感知调度器、子截止时间分配和MIMONet结构重构，在动态环境下保持端到端时序保证，并在NVIDIA Jetson和Apple M系列平台上验证了其在吞吐量、截止时间满足率、鲁棒性和适应性方面的优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人在动态环境中运行时，计算图会因新任务出现、优先级关系变化等工作负载演化而改变，导致多任务推理在紧资源与实时预算下性能下降，亟需一种能适应环境动态性同时保持端到端时序保证的调度框架。

Method: 提出RED框架，核心包括：(1)截止时间感知调度器，通过分配中间子截止时间适应演变计算图和异步推理；(2)支持MIMONet灵活部署；(3)利用共享参数特性进行工作负载细化和图重构，对齐MIMONet结构与可调度性需求。

Result: 在NVIDIA Jetson系列平台和Apple M系列MacBook上针对导航相关工作负载进行实验，RED在吞吐量、截止时间满足率、干扰鲁棒性、适应性和运行时开销方面均优于现有方法。

Conclusion: RED通过结合截止时间感知调度与MIMONet结构优化，为动态机器人环境下的实时多任务推理提供了一种有效且高效的解决方案，验证了共享参数特性在可调度性提升中的价值。

Abstract: Robots deployed in dynamic environments must contend with environment-driven changes that reshape computation at runtime: new tasks may appear, precedence relations can shift, and overall workload structure evolves, all of which degrade performance, especially when multi-task inference is required under tight resource and real-time budgets. We present RED, a real-time scheduling framework for multi-task deep neural network workloads on resource-constrained robotic platforms that adapts to Robotic Environmental Dynamics (RED) while preserving end-to-end timing guarantees under modeling assumptions. The core of RED is a deadline-aware scheduler that assigns intermediate sub-deadlines, allowing it to accommodate evolving computation graphs and asynchronous inference induced by unpredictable conditions. The framework also supports flexible deployment of MIMONet (multi-input multi-output neural networks), commonly used in multi-tasking robots to alleviate memory pressure through weight sharing. RED explicitly leverages this shared-parameter property via a workload refinement and graph-reconstruction procedure that aligns MIMONet structure with schedulability requirements, improving compatibility and efficiency. We implement RED on NVIDIA Jetson family platforms and on an Apple M-series MacBook and evaluate it on navigation-oriented workloads representative of real robotic scenarios. Experiments show consistent gains over existing methods in throughput, deadline satisfaction, robustness to interference, adaptability, and runtime overhead.

</details>


### [422] [MASt3R-Nav: WayPixel Navigation in Relative 3D Maps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24111)
*Vansh Garg,Rohit Jayanti,Krish Pandya,Sarthak Chittawar,Siddharth Tourani,Muhammad Haris Khan,Sourav Garg,Madhava Krishna*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于像素级相对几何连接的新型地图表示方法"WayPixel Costmap"，在不要求全局几何一致性的前提下实现精确几何导航，通过在图像对之间建立像素对应关系构建像素级图结构，并利用该稠密代价地图进行路径规划和控制器训练，在四个导航任务及真实场景中验证了其优越性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的3D地图需要全局一致的几何信息，而基于图像或物体的拓扑图虽然避免了这一限制，但导航能力受限（仅能"教-重复"）。作者希望找到一种既具有几何精度、又不需要全局几何一致性的地图表示方法。

Method: 1) 利用3D图像匹配技术，在图像对之间建立像素级对应关系，构建像素相对连接图；2) 对该像素级图进行近似和稀疏化处理，实现全局路径规划；3) 推导出"WayPixel Costmap"表示；4) 训练以该代价地图为条件的控制器，预测轨迹展开。

Result: 该稠密像素级代价地图作为控制预测的条件变量，比基于图像级和物体级的表示更精确；在四种导航任务的仿真和真实世界演示中均表现出高性能。

Conclusion: 像素级相对几何连接的代价地图能够兼顾几何精度和全局一致性要求，是一种更有效的导航控制条件表示，显著提升了导航系统的能力。

Abstract: Visual navigation ability is strongly tied to its underlying representation of the world. Unlike classical 3D maps that require globally-consistent geometry, image- or object-relative topological graphs almost entirely do away with geometric understanding. But, this comes at the cost of navigation capability, often limiting it to merely teach-and-repeat. In this work, we propose a novel map representation in the form of pixel-relative connectivity, which is geometrically accurate but does not require global geometric consistency. Inspired by recent progress in 3D grounded image matching, we construct a map from an image sequence through inter-image connectivity based on pixel correspondences in the relative 3D coordinate systems of individual image pairs. We then use this pixel-level graph to perform global path planning by approximating and sparsifying intra-image pixel connectivity. Through this, we derive a ''WayPixel Costmap'' representation and train a controller conditioned on it to predict a trajectory rollout. We show that this dense pixel-level costmap based on relative geometry is a more accurate conditioning variable for control prediction than its image- and object-level counterparts. This enables a highly capable navigation system, as validated on four types of navigation tasks in the simulator and through real world demonstrations.

</details>


### [423] [Anisotropic Diffusion-Driven Ergodic Coverage in Multi-Robot Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24125)
*Thales C. Silva,Anoop Kiran,Nora Ayanian*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于各向异性扩散（Perona-Malik方程）的遍历搜索方法，推广了传统的热方程遍历搜索方法，使多机器人系统能根据目标密度分布差异自适应调整搜索方向，并通过仿真验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统遍历搜索算法（如热方程驱动的各向同性扩散）在所有方向均匀传播误差，无法根据目标密度分布的变化灵活调整，限制了多机器人系统的搜索效率。

Method: 引入Perona-Malik各向异性扩散方程，利用其梯度信息指导智能体运动，将热方程作为本方法的一个特例，推广了径向基函数和热方程解的表达方式。

Result: 通过多场景仿真实验，证明了所提出的各向异性扩散方法比传统各向同性扩散方法更优，能更有效地引导多机器人系统进行遍历搜索。

Conclusion: 各向异性扩散为遍历搜索问题提供了一个更一般、更灵活的框架，能够根据目标分布变化自适应调整搜索行为，是多机器人协同搜索领域的重要进展。

Abstract: We consider the problem of combining potential field and ergodic search on multi-robot systems. Traditional ergodic search algorithms use metrics for ergodicity that account for the desired distribution at different scales. Recently, a heat equation-driven ergodic approach was proposed, which adds flexibility to the smoothing of the ergodic metric. However, such an approach, as it is an isotropic diffusion, propagates the error uniformly in all directions, regardless of changes in the desired distribution. We introduce a general class of anisotropic diffusion formulation of the ergodicity problem, which generates a potential field for the ergodic search. We demonstrate that this approach generalizes previous results, which consider radial basis functions and the solution of the heat equation to represent the difference between the goal density distribution and the covered trajectories. In our solution, the agent movement is directed using the gradient of the solution of the Perona-Malik diffusion, and our formulation includes the heat equation as a special case. We demonstrate the methodology with a series of simulations in different scenarios.

</details>


### [424] [Investigating the Effect of a Series Elastic Actuation Retrofit to Black-Box Actuators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24127)
*Ivan Tregear,Ayhan Aktas,Ferdinando Rodriguez y Baena*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文设计了一种低成本扭转型串联弹性执行器（SEA）模块，将其加装到现有刚性机械臂上，通过有限元分析设计弹性元件（刚度2155.4 Nm/rad），使力控带宽从10.32 Hz提升至30.32 Hz（提升2.93倍），且性能超过商用传感器7.63%，成本仅25英镑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统刚性执行器缺乏柔顺性，在不确定环境中易损坏且力控性能差。SEA虽能引入柔顺性，但会降低系统带宽。本文旨在设计一种可加装到现有黑箱执行器上的SE元件，在保留柔顺性的同时提升力控带宽和性能。

Method: 设计扭转型SE元件并通过有限元分析确定刚度（2155.4 Nm/rad）；将其加装到现有执行器上；分别测量原始电机和SEA集成配置的开环力控带宽，以及使用SEA反馈和商用传感器反馈的闭环带宽。

Result: SEA模块将力控带宽从10.32 Hz提升至30.32 Hz（提升2.93倍）；性能超越商用传感器7.63%；成本仅25英镑。

Conclusion: 通过加装低成本的SEA模块，能够有效提升现有刚性执行器的力控带宽和性能，同时保持柔顺性，是一种经济高效的机器人柔顺力控解决方案。

Abstract: In robotic applications, actuators are typically designed to be stiff with minimal backlash to ensure precision and repeatability. However, this limits compliance, leading to potential damage and poor force control in uncertain environments. Series Elastic Actuation (SEA) introduces compliance to enhance disturbance rejection and enable force measurement via Hooke's Law but reduces system bandwidth.
  A custom Series Elastic (SE) element was retrofitted to a black-box actuator to mitigate non-linearities like backlash and static friction. Integrating the SE element enabled high-fidelity force measurements, improving force control bandwidth and performance.
  A torsional SE element was designed through Finite Element (FE) analysis, yielding a stiffness of 2155.4 Nm/rad. Open-loop force control bandwidth was measured for the original motor and the SEA-integrated configuration, while closed-loop bandwidth was assessed using feedback from the SEA and a commercial force sensor. The SEA module increased bandwidth from 10.32 Hz to 30.32 Hz, a 2.93X improvement. Additionally, it outperformed the commercial sensor by 7.63% despite costing 25 GBP, a fraction of the price.

</details>


### [425] [Afford-VLA: Action-Aligned Visual Planning via Internalized Affordance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24203)
*Runze Wang,Yuqian Fu,Yu Li,Tao Lin,Tianwen Qian,Mohamed Elhoseiny,Bo Zhao,Yanwei Fu,Yu-Gang Jiang,Xiangyang Xue*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出Afford-VLA，通过在VLA模型内部引入可学习的<AFF>令牌来内化任务条件化的可供性（affordance）作为显式视觉规划接口，实现局部、视觉化、内部生成且与动作直接对齐的视觉规划，在多个仿真和真实环境任务中取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型在复杂视觉场景中空间推理能力不足，无法准确定位交互位置；已有的视觉规划方法依赖全局几何线索、符号中间表征或外部生成的视觉信号，与下游动作预测耦合较弱。

Method: 提出Afford-VLA框架：引入可学习的<AFF>令牌查询任务相关的交互区域，从多模态特征中解码可供性掩码，并将其转换为紧凑嵌入直接条件化动作生成，形成紧密耦合的感知-动作通路；采用联合优化训练策略同时优化可供性通路与动作预测。

Result: 在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、SimplerEnv等多个仿真基准和真实环境中取得一致的state-of-the-art性能。

Conclusion: 将可供性内化为与动作对齐的视觉规划是提升VLA系统的有效范式。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown strong potential for generalist robot manipulation, yet they remain limited by insufficient spatial reasoning, particularly in determining where to interact in complex visual scenes. While recent efforts introduce various forms of visual planning to address this issue, existing approaches either rely on global geometric cues, symbolic intermediate representations, or externally generated visual signals, which are often weakly coupled with downstream action prediction. In this work, we revisit visual planning in VLA systems and argue that effective planning should be local, visually grounded, internally generated, and directly aligned with action. Based on this insight, we propose Afford-VLA, a unified framework that internalizes task-conditioned affordance as an explicit visual planning interface within VLA models. Concretely, we introduce learnable <AFF> tokens to query task-relevant interaction regions, decode affordance masks from multimodal features, and convert them into compact embeddings that directly condition action generation. This design enables affordance to be both generated and utilized within the VLA, forming a tightly coupled perception-action pathway. To further support this integration, we adopt a training strategy that allows the affordance pathway to be jointly optimized with action prediction, improving its effectiveness for downstream control. We evaluate our method on multiple simulation benchmarks, including LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and SimplerEnv, achieving consistent state-of-the-art performance, along with strong real-world results. These findings demonstrate that internalizing affordance as action-aligned visual planning provides a powerful paradigm for improving VLA systems.

</details>


### [426] [ECo-MoE: Embodiment-Conditioned Mixture of Experts Increases the Evolvability of Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24225)
*Yibin Wang,Muhan Li,Zihan Guo,Sam Kriegman*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合专家进化学习框架（Eco-MoE），通过协同优化机器人设计向量（基因型）分布和门控神经模块（控制专家），实现形态与控制的联合进化，其中预训练专家策略可引导进化朝向特定形态结构（"演示进化"）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人形态-控制协同设计方法存在两难：为每个机器人单独训练策略效率低下，而采用统一的通用控制器又会导致过于保守的结构和行为。作者希望在这两个极端之间找到可扩展的折中方案。

Method: 提出混合专家进化框架：1) 维护一个潜在设计向量（基因型）分布用于解码机器人形态（表型）；2) 维护一个混合控制专家（神经模块），由每个解码头部的潜在坐标门控激活；3) 不同形态激活不同的传感器-运动回路组合，实现模块化知识保留；4) 支持将预训练专家策略直接插入混合体，引导进化朝向特定形态区域（"evo by demo"）。

Result: 该方法在三个维度取得优势：1) 可扩展性优于逐机器人训练策略；2) 灵活性优于单一通用控制器；3) "evo by demo"机制使预训练专家能引导自由进化朝向期望的规范形态结构。

Conclusion: 提出的框架在"个体策略"与"通用控制器"之间找到了有效的平衡点，通过模块化知识保留和预训练专家引导，实现了更高效的形态-控制协同进化。

Abstract: In this paper, we introduce a model of evolution and learning in robots that co-optimizes a distribution of latent design vectors (genotypes) and a mixture of control experts (neural modules), which are gated by the latent coordinates of each decoded design (phenotype). This provides a scalable alternative to co-design algorithms that either train an individual policy for every robot, which is inefficient, or a monolithic universal controller for all robots, which results in overly conservative structures and behaviors. Our approach lies somewhere between these two extremes, preserving ancestral knowledge in a unified yet modular framework in which different body plans activate and deactivate different combinations of learned sensorimotor circuits for goal-directed behavior. This allows one part of the controller to be overhauled to better suit new species of designs as they emerge without disrupting the hard-earned knowledge contained within other expert modules. It also allows pretrained expert policies to be directly plugged into the mixture, which can steer evolution into otherwise unexplored areas of latent space containing desired morphological traits. We refer to this process as "evo by demo" and explore how it may be used to guide freeform evolution toward canonical structures defined by the pretrained model. Videos and code can be found at: https://eco-moe.github.io.

</details>


### [427] [AcroRL: Learning Aggressive Quadrotor Inversion using Bidirectional Thrust](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24301)
*Gabriel Rodriguez,Henri Sayag,Abhishek Rathod,John Stecklein,Siddharth Saha,Christopher Barngrover,Wennie Tabib*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于强化学习的框架，通过调制恒定参考轨迹，实现四旋翼飞行器在紧凑位置约束下的双向推力反转（从正飞到倒飞及反向），相比传统优化方法，位置RMSE降低32%， settling time降低57%，并在硬件实验中验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有双向推力几何控制方法在反转过程中存在执行器饱和、电机反转延迟等问题，需要启发式推力姿态调度和航点调参，缺乏高效、紧凑的解决方案。

Method: 采用强化学习分别训练两个策略（正飞→倒飞和倒飞→正飞），通过调制恒定参考轨迹实现紧凑位置约束下的四旋翼反转，保持与传统轨迹生成和跟踪的兼容性。

Result: 在JAX仿真中，位置RMSE降低32%，settling time降低57%；硬件实验中多偏航构型下位置RMSE低于0.35m，并成功演示了双飞行模式下的圆形轨迹飞行。

Conclusion: 所提学习框架有效解决了四旋翼反转中的控制难题，显著优于优化基线方法，且具备良好的实用性和兼容性，已开源实现。

Abstract: Bidirectional thrust grants quadrotors a second equilibrium condition and increased control authority, expanding the envelope of possible aggressive maneuvers and enabling inverted flight, perching, and sensing. Prior geometric control approaches extend differential flatness through Hopf fibration-based attitude representations to support bidirectional thrust, but struggle with actuator saturation and motor reversal delay during inversions, requiring heuristic thrust posture scheduling and waypoint tuning. We propose a learning-based framework that modulates a constant reference trajectory to perform compact, position-constrained quadrotor inversions while remaining compatible with traditional trajectory generation and tracking across flight regimes. Separate policies are trained via reinforcement learning for nominal-to-inverted and inverted-to-nominal transitions. In JAX-based simulation, the proposed method achieves the lowest position deviation and settling time across all evaluated baselines, reducing position root mean square error (RMSE) by 32% and settling time by 57% relative to the strongest optimization-based baseline. Hardware experiments demonstrate successful inversion across multiple yaw configurations with position RMSE below 0.35m, and compatibility with downstream trajectory generation and control through circular flight in both regimes. Additionally, we provide an open-source implementation of the proposed framework.

</details>


### [428] [Terrain-Adaptive Grouser Wheel for Optimal Planetary Exploration: Design and Experimental Investigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24311)
*Vincent Griffo,Yashwanth Kumar Nakka*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种可连续调节轮刺高度的多模态车轮[匿名化机器人名]，通过750次实验证明该设计能在不同颗粒地形上减少30-58%的打滑率，并提升77.4%的行驶时间和能耗效率，验证了轮刺自适应形态在行星探测中的潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 行星漫游车在颗粒状地形中常遇到打滑等机动性挑战，现有研究虽探索了刚度、直径等调整方式，但完全可调节轮刺的设计尚属空白。颗粒地形通常需要更高的轮刺来提升牵引性能，因此作者希望开发一种能连续调节轮刺高度的自适应车轮。

Method: 设计了一种可连续调节轮刺高度的多模态车轮[匿名化机器人名]，在四种代表性表面（乙烯基地板、粗岩石、豌豆砾石、两种密实状态的沙子）上进行750次实验，对比自适应部署与固定配置的性能差异，并基于实验数据构建简化缩放分析以建立颗粒度与最优轮刺高度的关系。

Result: 自适应部署在颗粒地形上减少打滑30.0-58.0%，行驶时间和能耗提升高达77.4%。不同地形下并不存在单一最优轮刺高度，验证了固定轮系统的局限性。

Conclusion: 轮刺自适应形态（如[匿名化机器人名]）是提升行星漫游车在多样且高机动性挑战的星外环境中移动能力的有效解决方案。

Abstract: Planetary rovers operating in extraterrestrial environments often encounter significant mobility challenges due to varying terrain features such as gradients and granularity. While recent works in multimodal wheel design have explored adjustments in stiffness, compliance, and diameter as a means to improve terrain adaptability, full wheel grouser-adjustable designs remain largely unexplored. Grousers are a compelling feature to actuate, as granular terrains tend to require increased grouser height for improved wheel performance. As a result, we introduce [Anonymized Robot Name], a multimodal wheel capable of continuously adjusting its grouser height for terrain adaptation. The platform was evaluated across four representative surfaces, including vinyl flooring, coarse rock, pea gravel, and sand under two packing states, spanning a range of granular conditions. Results from 750 experimental trials demonstrate that adaptive deployment reduces slip by 30.0--58.0\% and improves travel time and energy consumption by up to 77.4\% in granular regimes relative to fixed configurations. Using the terrain trial data, a simplified scaling analysis was developed and validated, suggesting a relationship between terrain granularity and optimal grouser height for the tested configuration. No single grouser height minimized slip across all terrains, underscoring the limitations of fixed-wheel systems commonly used for planetary exploration. This observation reinforces the potential of grouser-adaptive morphology, such as [Anonymized Robot Name], as an effective solution for enhancing rover mobility across diverse and mobility-challenging extraterrestrial environments.

</details>


### [429] [IsaacIPC: Coupling High-Fidelity Simulation and Realistic Rendering for Contact-Rich Robotic Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24339)
*Qixin Liang,Zhongqing Han*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: IsaacIPC是一个将GPU加速的增量势接触(IPC)与IsaacSim/Lab结合的机器人仿真框架，并提出了几何砂浆接触势(GMCP)以更好地解析触觉传感中的接触-压力分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人仿真框架在处理变形体与触觉传感时存在计算效率低、接触压力分布解析不准确的问题，亟需一种高效且精确的仿真方法。

Method: 1) 将GPU加速的IPC与IsaacSim/Lab耦合，实现仿真网格与视觉网格之间的变形映射；2) 提出GMCP方法，在触觉表面接触样本上定义屏障势以优化接触-压力分布解析。

Result: 在接触基准测试中验证了GMCP的有效性，并在四足机器人、灵巧手和UMI夹爪的刚-柔耦合机器人仿真中展示了IsaacIPC的性能。

Conclusion: IsaacIPC结合GMCP为变形体机器人的实时仿真、数据收集和策略评估提供了高效且精确的框架，尤其在触觉感知方面有显著提升。

Abstract: We present IsaacIPC, a robotic simulation framework that couples GPU accelerated incremental potential contact (IPC) with IsaacSim/Lab. IsaacIPC maps simulated deformation between simulation and visual meshes, enabling real-time realistic rendering with applications to data collection and policy evaluation. For tactile sensing, we introduce the geometric mortar contact potential (GMCP), which defines a barrier potential over contact samples on tactile surfaces to better resolve contact-pressure distributions. We evaluate GMCP on contact benchmarks and demonstrate IsaacIPC on rigid-deformable robotic simulations including a quadruped robot, a dexterous hand, and a universal manipulation interface (UMI) gripper.

</details>


### [430] [PACT: Proactive Asking for Continual Task Assistance in Human-Robot Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24350)
*Chengbo He,Sheng Li,Chenyang Ma,Bochao Zou,Li Sun,Jiansheng Chen,Junliang Xing,Yuanchun Shi,Huimin Ma*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出PACT框架，让机器人在长期人机协作中通过主动询问来平衡澄清需求与行动执行，从而在部分观察条件下持续提升辅助准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在长期人机协作中，机器人面临部分观察和跨日交互历史利用的挑战，且用户特质与习惯在初期未知，被动推断后行动的方式效率低下。

Method: 提出PACT（Proactive Asking for Continual Task Assistance）框架，基于当前观察与累积交互历史评估上下文充分性，决定是主动询问还是直接行动；主要实例化采用强化学习实现。

Result: 在多日具身协作场景实验中，与被动推断基线相比，PACT在辅助准确性和澄清效用（新提出的评估指标）上均有一致提升。

Conclusion: 主动询问在持续人机协作中具有重要意义，PACT框架能有效平衡辅助准确性与询问频率，逐步适应用户。

Abstract: Robotic assistants in long-term human-robot collaboration need to assist users under partial observations while leveraging cross-day interaction history. However, human traits and routines are often unknown at the beginning of collaboration, making passive infer-then-act assistance ineffective and inefficient. To address this challenge, we study a cross-day proactive asking setting for continual task assistance and propose PACT (Proactive Asking for Continual Task Assistance), an ask-or-act framework that determines whether clarification should be sought before taking action. PACT leverages current observations together with accumulated interaction history to evaluate contextual sufficiency, enabling the robot to provide more reliable assistance and progressively adapt to the user over time. We implement its primary learned instantiation using reinforcement learning and evaluate alternative instantiations under the same framework. To assess such behavior, we further introduce a clarification utility metric that quantifies the trade-off between assistance accuracy and the frequency of clarification requests. Experiments in multi-day embodied collaboration scenarios demonstrate that, compared with passive inference baselines, PACT consistently improves both assistance accuracy and clarification utility, highlighting the importance of proactive asking in continual human-robot collaboration.

</details>


### [431] [RoboHitch: Learning Visual Affordance from Disordered Keypoints for Hitch Knots Tying](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24394)
*Jiahui Zuo,Boyang Zhang,Fumin Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: RoboHitch是一个从人类演示中学习打结的框架，仅使用无序3D关键点和RGB图像，通过图自编码器和卷积自编码器融合多模态信息，实现隐式状态推理和打结操作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人打结方法严重依赖精确的拓扑状态追踪（有序关键点和显式边连接），在重复弯曲和交叉时容易出现追踪漂移和拓扑不匹配问题，导致失败率高。

Method: 提出RoboHitch框架：(1) 动态图自编码器提取无序关键点的几何特征；(2) 卷积自编码器捕获视觉上下文；(3) 双向交叉注意力机制融合多模态特征，联合预测拾取和放置位置（affordances）。

Result: 在真实世界实验中，RoboHitch成功完成了存在自遮挡情况下的打结任务，验证了其有效性和泛化能力。

Conclusion: 通过消除对显式拓扑顺序的依赖，RoboHitch提供了一种更灵活的机器人操作可变形线性对象的方法，能够应对遮挡等复杂场景。

Abstract: Robotic manipulation of deformable linear objects (DLOs) presents significant challenges due to complex dynamics and frequent self-occlusions. Existing robotic knot tying methods typically rely on precise topological state tracking with ordered keypoints and explicit edge connectivity. This reliance makes them prone to failures due to tracking drift and topology mismatch caused by repeated bending and crossings during knot formation.To address these limitations, we introduce RoboHitch, a novel framework that learns to perform hitch knot tying from human demonstrations using only disordered 3D keypoints and RGB images. This eliminates the need for explicit topological order, allowing for more flexible manipulation. Our method employs a dynamic Graph Autoencoder to extract geometric features from untracked keypoints, complemented by a Convolutional Autoencoder that captures essential visual context. A bidirectional cross-attention mechanism then fuses these modalities to jointly predict pick and place affordances, facilitating implicit reasoning about the rope's state and enabling knot tying under occlusion.Real-world experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and generalizability of our approach, successfully completing hitch knots in scenarios with self-occlusions.

</details>


### [432] [Smoother Action Chunking Flow Policy via Prior-Corrected Orthogonal Trust-Region Guidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24433)
*Kai Fang,Hailong Pei,Xuemin Chi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: POTR提出了一种先验校正正交信任区域引导方法，通过改进引导权重调度和约束校正方向，在机器人动作分块策略中提升了闭环控制的平滑性和成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的RTC引导方法在中间时间步校正力度弱，且未约束校正方向，可能引入横向扰动，导致动作不连续。

Method: 1) 引入数据先验尺度σ_d增强中间时间步的校正权重；2) 将引导向量分解为平行与垂直于去噪速度的分量，并对垂直分量施加信任区域约束。

Result: 在LIBERO + π0.5上，POTR相比RTC提升了成功率，并持续降低了分块边界不连续性、加速度和加加速度。

Conclusion: 先验校正权重提供了主要的校正增益，正交信任区域进一步提升了稳定性。

Abstract: Flow-matching robot policies commonly use action-chunking inference for efficient closed-loop control, but chunk boundaries can introduce discontinuous action transitions. Existing RTC guidance improves continuity by injecting correction signals during denoising, yet its weight schedule is weak at intermediate timesteps and its unconstrained correction direction may introduce transverse perturbations. We propose POTR, a **p**rior-corrected **o**rthogonal **t**rust-**r**egion guidance method. First, we incorporate a data-prior scale $σ_d$ into the RTC guidance weight, yielding stronger intermediate-time correction. Second, we decompose the guidance vector into components parallel and perpendicular to the denoising velocity, and constrain the perpendicular component within a trust region. On LIBERO with $π_{0.5}$, POTR improves success rate and consistently reduces chunk-boundary discontinuity, acceleration, and jerk compared with RTC. Ablations show that the prior-corrected weight provides the main correction gain, while the orthogonal trust region further improves stability.

</details>


### [433] [Vision-Guided Outdoor Flight and Obstacle Evasion via Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24449)
*Shiladitya Dutta,Aayush Gupta,Varun Saran,Avideh Zakhor*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于立体视觉深度和VIO的无人机自主导航策略，通过两阶段训练（监督学习+课程学习微调）实现零样本迁移到未知环境和无人机平台。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 四旋翼无人机在复杂环境中需要持续人工操控，限制了其在GNSS和遥测信号缺失场景下的应用，因此需要一种自主导航策略。

Method: 采用预训练自编码器作为感知前端，结合LSTM规划控制网络输出速度指令。通过两阶段训练：1) 全局运动规划器生成最优轨迹进行监督学习；2) 课程环境微调。使用域随机化和奖励塑形缩小仿真到现实的差距。

Result: 在室外实验中，方法实现了零样本迁移，成功部署到训练中从未见过的障碍环境和无人机平台上。

Conclusion: 提出的传感器运动策略能够有效实现无人机在未知环境中的自主避障导航，且具有良好的泛化能力。

Abstract: Although quadcopters boast impressive traversal capabilities enabled by their omnidirectional maneuverability, the need for continuous pilot control in complex environments impedes their application in GNSS and telemetry-denied scenarios. To this end, we propose a novel sensorimotor policy that uses stereo-vision depth and visual-inertial odometry (VIO) to autonomously navigate through obstacles in an unknown environment to reach a goal point. The policy is comprised of a pre-trained autoencoder as the perception head followed by a planning and control LSTM network which outputs velocity commands that can be followed by an off-the-shelf commercial drone. We leverage reinforcement and privileged learning paradigms to train the policy in simulation through a two-stage process: 1) initial training with optimal trajectories generated by a global motion planner acting as a supervisory backbone, 2) further fine-tuning in a curriculum environment. To bridge the sim-to-real gap, we employ domain randomization and reward shaping to create a policy that is both robust to noise and domain shift. In outdoor experiments, our approach achieves successful zero-shot transfer to both obstacle environments and a drone platform that were never encountered during training.

</details>


### [434] [Polymander II: an amphibious salamander-inspired robot with contact and flow sensors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24465)
*Qiyuan Fu,Sudong Lee,Andrea Grillo,Jonathan Arreguit,Louis Gevers,Josie Hughes,Auke J. Ijspeert*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于霍尔效应传感器的两栖机器人解决方案，用于感知足底接触力和侧向水动力，实现高速采集外部和本体信息，并展示了其在两栖环境中的运动能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有两栖机器人缺乏同时感知陆地和水下环境交互的能力，限制了其对复杂地形的适应性和鲁棒性。

Method: 采用霍尔效应传感器感知足底接触力和侧向水动力，通过两条总线同时以500Hz以上采集外部信息和100Hz采集关节位置、载荷等本体信息。传感器体积小、灵敏度高，且可与被测物体分离放置，便于防水封装。

Result: 成功实现两栖环境穿越，验证了传感器在小力下的高灵敏度，并展示了反馈控制用于更复杂运动的潜力。

Conclusion: 该传感方案有效提升了仿蝾螈两栖机器人的环境感知能力，为两栖机器人的闭环控制提供了基础。

Abstract: Robots benefit from sensory information to coordinate body movement, gain robustness against perturbations, and transit between different modes to adapt to various terrains. However, few amphibious robots can sense interactions with both terrestrial and aquatic environments. In this paper, we present a solution that uses Hall-effect sensors to sense foot contact forces and lateral hydrodynamic forces on a salamander-inspired amphibious robot. With two bus lines, the robot can simultaneously acquire this exteroceptive information at more than 500 Hz and proprioceptive information, such as joint positions and loads, at 100 Hz. The Hall-effect sensors used are compact, making them suitable for embedding in multiple positions within a robot, and exhibit high sensitivity to small forces. Moreover, because the sensor can be positioned separately from the measured object, waterproofing can be implemented with relative ease. Our tests demonstrate the robot's capabilities in traversing amphibious environments and its potential in using feedback control for more complex locomotion tasks.

</details>


### [435] [Elevator-LIO: Robust LiDAR-Inertial Odometry for Multi-Floor Navigation under Elevator-Induced Non-Inertial Motion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24495)
*Yifan Zhang,Yudong Huang,Yuchong Zhang,Changze Li,Haoran Liu,Ming Yang,Tong Qin*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Elevator-LIO 是一种面向电梯场景的激光雷达-惯性里程计框架，通过在非惯性系中建立解耦状态估计模型，实现机器人在电梯内连续定位与跨楼层任务，在79次电梯数据中表现出高精度和稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LIO方法在电梯等非惯性系环境下无法连续稳定定位，导致跨楼层机器人任务受限。

Method: 提出解耦状态估计模型，分离机器人相对电梯运动和电梯自身运动，嵌入模式依赖的迭代误差状态卡尔曼滤波框架；设计电梯模式管理器检测进出事件并引入零速/零加速度更新；采用自适应体素降采样策略应对环境尺度变化。

Result: 在20个真实序列（79次电梯乘行）中，所有序列均保持连续定位精度，其中17个序列终端高度误差低于1cm；在Hilti 2022/2023数据集上也表现竞争性。

Conclusion: Elevator-LIO有效解决了电梯场景下的连续定位问题，在精度和鲁棒性上显著优于现有代表性定位系统。

Abstract: This paper presents Elevator-LIO, a LiDAR-inertial odometry framework designed to achieve continuous robot localization during elevator travel, thereby supporting cross-floor robotic tasks. To address the state-estimation problem in non-inertial frames, Elevator-LIO establishes a decoupled state-estimation model that separately models the robot motion relative to the elevator and the elevator motion itself, and embeds it into a mode-dependent iterated error-state Kalman filter framework. This framework degenerates to conventional LIO estimation in ordinary indoor environments, while enabling the propagation and constrained update of elevator-related states in elevator non-inertial environments, thereby achieving continuous and stable localization. An elevator mode manager detects elevator entry and exit events using LiDAR ranging statistics and estimated states, and introduces event-triggered zero-velocity and zero-acceleration updates when the elevator stops to suppress accumulated vertical drift. In addition, this paper adopts an adaptive voxel downsampling strategy to maintain a stable number of effective points under significant environmental scale changes. We conduct extensive experiments on 20 real-world sequences containing 79 elevator rides, including practical challenges such as large-scale spaces, long vertical travel, dynamic pedestrian interference, and mirror reflections. The results show that Elevator-LIO maintains continuous localization accuracy in all sequences, with terminal height error below 1 cm in 17 sequences. In contrast, existing representative localization systems perform poorly on these elevator sequences. Tests on the Hilti 2022/2023 datasets further show that the proposed method remains competitive in standard indoor scenarios. The project page is available at https://xiaofan4122.github.io/Elevator_LIO_Page/.

</details>


### [436] [MuGen: Multi-Skill Generative Locomotion Controller for Humanoid Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24592)
*Yusen Feng,Xiang Wang,Heyuan Yao,Zixi Kang,Xinyu Huo,Boyang Yu,Pengyun Qiu,Ruijie Zhao,Baoquan Chen,Libin Liu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MuGen是一个数据驱动的框架，利用VQ-VAE和模型强化学习，使类人机器人能够学习并执行多种表达性动作，通过教师-学生策略蒸馏实现从人类运动数据到机器人部署的高效迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 让类人机器人能够像人类一样执行富有表现力的多技能运动，而非传统单一的、僵化的运动模式。

Method: 使用VQ-VAE结合基于模型的强化学习从异构人类运动数据中学习运动表征，再通过教师-学生框架和新策略蒸馏方法部署到机器人上。

Result: 机器人能够追踪和模仿未见过的真实人类运动，并能将学到的潜在空间迁移到其他任务中，实现多样化的运动集和精确执行。

Conclusion: MuGen框架有效实现了类人机器人从人类运动数据中学习并部署多技能运动的能力，具备良好的泛化性和可迁移性。

Abstract: This paper presents MuGen, a data-driven framework for learning and deploying multi-skill locomotion on humanoid robots. MuGen enables a robot to perform expressive motions like humans under the guidance of example motion sequences. To achieve this, we employ vector-quantized autoencoders (VQ-VAEs) trained with model-based reinforcement learning, resulting in a generative representation of locomotion that captures key patterns of human motion from hours of heterogeneous human performance data. We employ a teacher-student learning framework and develop a new policy distillation strategy to enable a deployable student policy learning this efficient latent representation. This policy allows the robot to track and mimic unseen human motions and further enables the robot to reuse the learned latent space for other tasks. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework through a diverse set of motions and accurate execution.

</details>


### [437] [PoseRefer: Pathway-Local Parameters for Semantically Grounded Reference Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24622)
*Anna Deichler*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出MM-Conv数据集（基于VR双人交互的自然共言语手势），并通过解耦的晚期融合架构研究姿态与语言融合，发现类别表征对语义接地系统的准确性有显著影响，强调架构解耦对评估融合性能的必要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D接地基准仅部分捕捉真实场景中手势、语言和场景几何的融合（如描述事后编写、手势模板化或为相机编排），缺乏自然的共言语手势数据。本文旨在通过VR双人交互收集自然数据，并设计解耦架构以评估姿态-语言融合的真实效果。

Method: 1) 构建MM-Conv数据集：通过VR双人交互捕获自然的共言语手势、全身动作捕捉和3D场景图。2) 提出解耦的晚期融合架构：姿态和文本路径不共享学习参数，使用冻结的MiniLM类别嵌入进行融合。3) 通过控制消融实验隔离类别、姿态和文本的贡献，并引入学习标量门控机制。

Result: 融合冻结MiniLM类别嵌入在所有指代类型上超过纯姿态和最佳纯文本路径，达到31.9% top-1准确率。学习标量门控在文本路径是否有类别访问权限时翻转相反策略，表明类别表征是影响融合准确性评估的关键因素。

Conclusion: 语义接地系统的融合准确性声明若未在架构上解耦路径，则与类别表征伪影不可区分。强调架构解耦作为可靠性诊断的必要性，为未来多模态接地研究提供方法论指导。

Abstract: A robot resolving ``put the cup on that one'' must fuse gesture, language, and scene geometry, yet 3D grounding benchmarks only partially capture this regime: descriptions are written post-hoc, gestures are templated, or pointing is staged for the camera. MM-Conv captures natural co-speech gesture from dyadic VR interaction alongside full-body motion capture and 3D scene graphs. We use it to evaluate pose-language fusion with a decoupled late-fusion architecture in which pose and text pathways share no learned parameters. The two choices together make category, pose, and text contributions easier to isolate through controlled ablations. Fusion with frozen MiniLM category embeddings exceeds pose alone and the best text-only pathway on every reference type, reaching 31.9% top-1. The learned scalar gate flips between opposing policies depending on whether the text pathway has category access. This is a reliability diagnostic: fusion-accuracy claims for semantic grounding systems are indistinguishable from category-representation artifacts unless pathways are architecturally decoupled.

</details>


### [438] [Towards Low-Gravity Planetary Exploration using Reinforcement Learning for Walking, Jumping, and In-flight Attitude Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24643)
*Jørgen Anker Olsen,Kostas Alexis*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出基于强化学习的四足机器人运动策略，专为火星低重力环境设计，实现行走、垂直/前向跳跃及空中姿态控制，使机器人能跨越自身尺寸的障碍物。仿真验证了3.1米垂直跳跃和3.9米前向跳跃，实物实验实现2.6秒内90°姿态调整。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有四足机器人在低重力行星探索场景下的运动能力有限，难以跨越较大障碍物。本文旨在利用强化学习开发适用于火星重力条件的动态运动策略，使机器人具备超越自身尺寸的跳跃与姿态控制能力。

Method: 基于五杆腿设计的任务优化四足机器人，使用强化学习分别训练行走、垂直跳跃、前向跳跃和空中姿态控制策略。所有策略针对火星低重力环境进行显式优化，并通过Sim2Real迁移验证姿态控制策略在实物机器人上的有效性。

Result: 实物实验中，姿态控制策略实现2.6秒内90°姿态调整；仿真中实现3.1米垂直跳跃和3.9米前向跳跃（火星重力条件）。完整任务场景演示了各策略的协同部署效果。

Conclusion: 强化学习使四足机器人在火星低重力环境下具备超越自身尺寸的障碍跨越能力，验证了Sim2Real迁移的可行性，为行星探测提供了新的运动控制方案。

Abstract: This paper presents reinforcement learning (RL) policies for dynamic quadrupedal locomotion in planetary exploration scenarios. Building on a taskoptimized quadruped with a 5-bar leg design, we develop RL policies for walking, vertical jumping, forward jumping, and in-flight attitude control, explicitly tailored to the reduced gravity on Mars. These policies jointly enable such robots to overcome obstacles larger than themselves through coordinated jumping and precise in-flight reorientation for safe landings. We demonstrate Sim2Real transfer of the attitude control policy on the Olympus quadruped through single-axis reorientation tests, while all locomotion policies are validated in simulation. A complete Mars exploration mission scenario demonstrates coordinated policy deployment across challenging terrain. Experimental results show 90° attitude reorientation in 2.6 seconds, with simulations demonstrating 3.1 meter vertical jumps and 3.9 meter forward jumps under Martian gravity conditions. - Supplementary video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qlSJ3P87A4A

</details>


### [439] [Sum of Costs Diffusion with Dynamic Guidance for Motion Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24690)
*Aysu Aylin Kaplan,Özgür Erkent*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于扩散模型的高泛化能力运动规划方法，通过碰撞成本梯度引导去噪过程，并采用动态梯度引导起始步选择策略，在Mπnets数据集上取得了最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人操作运动规划方法（无论是经典方法还是深度学习方法）在泛化到不同场景时面临显著挑战，亟需一种高泛化能力的方法。

Method: 利用扩散模型生成无碰撞轨迹，去噪过程中由总碰撞成本的梯度进行引导；同时提出了一种动态选择梯度引导起始步的策略。

Result: 在Mπnets数据集的多样化测试场景中，所提方法相比对比方法取得了最高性能，展现出更强的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 动态碰撞成本引导的扩散模型能够有效克服现有方法的泛化问题，在机器人操作运动规划任务中具有显著优势。

Abstract: The motion planning problem for robotic manipulation can be addressed through classical or deep learning approaches. Existing methods face significant challenges in generalizing to diverse settings. In this study, we present a method with high generalization capability that generates collision-free trajectories using diffusion models where the denoising process is guided by the gradient of the total collision cost. We are also presenting a dynamic approach for choosing start step of the gradient guidance. Experimental results demonstrate that guiding the diffusion model dynamically with the sum of collision costs offers more robust performance by overcoming the generalization issues faced by competing methods. The proposed model demonstrates its effectiveness by achieving the highest performance on diverse test settings in M$π$nets\ dataset among the compared methods.

</details>


### [440] [Geometric Workspace Analysis and Transmission-Aware Dynamics of a Serial Spherical Tool for Microsurgery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24760)
*Anestis Mablekos-Alexiou,Lyndon da Cruz,Christos Bergeles*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种针对显微外科的串行球面机构（带额外平移自由度）的运动学与传动感知设计框架，包含解析工作空间公式、自锁传动动力学方法以及开源软件包，并通过玻璃体视网膜手术机器人工具实验验证了模型的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 显微外科手术（如玻璃体视网膜手术）需要高精度、小工作空间且具有自锁特性的机器人机构，现有设计缺乏兼顾运动学分析、传动动力学与工程实用性的统一框架。

Method: 1) 提出解析工作空间公式，无需数值优化即可快速选择旋转轴方向；2) 开发基于自锁传动的动力学方法，评估特定工作空间的扭矩需求；3) 提供开源软件包用于摩擦识别和逆动力学分析。

Result: 在玻璃体视网膜手术专用机器人工具上的实验验证了模型的预测能力，并展示了其在工程设计中的实用价值。

Conclusion: 该框架为显微外科球面机构的设计提供了理论工具与开源实现，可有效指导实际工程应用。

Abstract: We present a kinematic and transmission-aware design framework for a serial spherical mechanism with an additional translational degree of freedom for microsurgery. The first contribution is an analytical workspace formulation that provides geometric insight into reachable motion and enables rapid selection of rotation axis orientations without numerical optimization. The second contribution is a dynamics-informed methodology for mechanisms driven by self-locking transmissions, supporting evaluation of torque requirements for a prescribed workspace geometry. The framework is accompanied by an open-source software package for friction identification and inverse dynamics analysis. Experiments on a purpose-built robotic tool for vitreoretinal surgery validate the predictive capability of the models and demonstrate their practical utility for engineering design.

</details>


### [441] [Enhanced INS/GNSS State Estimation using GNSS-Based Acceleration Measurements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24767)
*Gal Versano,Itzik Klein*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出利用历史GNSS测量和运动模型提取车辆加速度信息，并将其融入INS/GNSS滤波器，在两组实地无人车数据集上实现了定位精度分别提升11.40%和20.74%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准INS/GNSS融合仅依赖GNSS位置更新，导致姿态和惯性传感器误差状态可观测性不足，尤其在低动态运动中定位精度受限。

Method: 利用历史GNSS测量结合运动模型提取车辆加速度信息，将其作为额外观测融入INS/GNSS滤波器，增强系统可观测性。

Result: 在两个不同平台和传感器等级的实地无人车数据集上，平均位置RMSE分别改善11.40%和20.74%。

Conclusion: 所提加速度辅助方法能有效提升INS/GNSS融合系统的定位鲁棒性和精度，优于传统仅位置辅助的滤波器。

Abstract: Accurate and reliable navigation is essential for autonomous ground vehicle operations. Standard INS/GNSS fusion relies on GNSS position updates, which provide limited observability of orientation and inertial sensor error states, particularly during low-dynamic motion. In this work, we propose utilizing past GNSS measurements alongside a motion model to extract meaningful vehicle acceleration information. This acceleration measurement is then integrated into the INS/GNSS filter to improve its robustness and accuracy. The proposed approach is evaluated on two real-world unmanned ground vehicle datasets collected from different mobile platforms and inertial sensor grades. Results demonstrate consistent positioning accuracy improvements relative to the standard position-aided filter, with mean position root mean square error improvements of 11.40 % and 20.74 % on the two datasets, respectively.

</details>


### [442] [MR-LiDAR: A Multi-Resolution Roadside LiDAR Benchmark for Perception Diagnostics and Deployment Guidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24777)
*Shunlai Cui,Peng Cao,Yuan Zhu,Yongjiang He,Jiacheng Yin,Xiao Huo,Gang Cao,Xiaobo Liu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出MR-LiDAR，一个用于路侧感知的多分辨率激光雷达基准数据集（16/32/80/128线），通过控制变量实验发现：80线优化光束分布的激光雷达可匹配甚至超越128线均匀分布激光雷达的性能，为路侧感知中经济高效的激光雷达选型提供了实证参考。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 路侧感知系统中激光雷达选型至关重要，但缺乏不同配置下感知性能的实证基准，导致传感器选型和部署规划受限。

Method: 在相同路侧场景下，使用16、32、80、128线激光雷达采集点云数据并标注；通过控制光束数量和分布等变量，系统分析各因素对感知性能的影响。

Result: 光束数量、光束分布、目标距离、目标类别和车辆遮挡均显著影响感知性能；80线优化分布的激光雷达可匹敌甚至超越128线均匀分布的激光雷达。

Conclusion: MR-LiDAR为路侧感知中的激光雷达选型提供了诊断基准和实用指南，表明优化光束分布比单纯增加光束数量更具性价比。

Abstract: LiDAR model selection is a critical issue in roadside sensing systems, as it directly determines both perception capability and deployment cost. However, the lack of empirical benchmarks for comparing perception performance across different LiDAR configurations has greatly constrained scientific sensor selection and deployment planning. To address this gap, we present MR-LiDAR, a controlled multi-resolution LiDAR benchmark for roadside perception diagnostics. Using 16-, 32-, 80-, and 128-beam LiDARs in identical roadside scenarios, we collect point clouds and ground-truth annotations for diverse traffic participants, including vehicles and vulnerable road users (VRUs), across varying distances. This controlled design isolates intrinsic LiDAR specifications, particularly beam count and beam distribution, as the key variables for precise performance diagnostics. Based on MR-LiDAR, we conduct systematic empirical analyses to examine how beam count, beam distribution, target distance, object category, and vehicle occlusion affect LiDAR perception performance. The results reveal that all of these factors have substantial impacts. In particular, contrary to the common assumption that higher beam counts always yield better perception, we show that an 80-beam LiDAR with optimized beam distribution can match or even outperform a 128-beam LiDAR with uniform beam distribution. In addition, we provide a practical reference guide for LiDAR selection, including target point-count statistics and detection performance comparisons based on two widely used detection algorithms. This work offers a diagnostic benchmark and practical guidance for determining cost-effective LiDAR configurations in roadside perception applications.

</details>


### [443] [Manifold-Constrained MPPI: Real-Time Sampling-Based Control Under Hard Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24813)
*Seulchan Lee,Sanghyun Kim*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MC-MPPI提出了一种结合变分自编码器（VAE）与二次规划（QP）的采样型模型预测控制方法，通过将约束解耦为潜空间规划和执行层修正，实现了对闭链机械臂等高约束系统的实时硬约束满足，在14自由度双臂系统仿真与真实实验中达到100Hz稳定运行，显著优于基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准MPPI仅依赖基于代价的软惩罚，无法保证硬约束满足，严重限制了其在闭链操作等高约束任务中的应用。

Method: 将约束最优控制问题解耦为潜空间规划（VAE学习约束流形的低维潜在表示，MPPI生成近可行轨迹）和执行层修正（利用参考轨迹线性化等式约束，通过单个QP求解器消除残余流形偏差）。

Result: 在14自由度闭链双臂系统上，MC-MPPI以100Hz稳定运行，有效维持硬等式约束，动态环境导航性能稳定，跟踪精度显著优于基线方法。

Conclusion: 通过解耦规划与修正的策略，MC-MPPI在保持MPPI计算优势的同时实现了硬约束保证，为高约束任务提供了实时可行的控制框架。

Abstract: Sampling-based model predictive control methods, such as Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI), offer derivative-free optimization and robustness in complex robotic systems. However, standard MPPI relies on cost-based soft penalties that cannot guarantee hard-constraint satisfaction, severely limiting its applicability to highly constrained tasks such as closed-chain manipulation. To address this, we propose Manifold-Constrained MPPI (MC-MPPI), a real-time sampling-based control framework that enforces manifold-based equality constraints while preserving the computational advantages of MPPI. The key idea is to decouple the constrained optimal control problem into latent-space planning and execution-level correction. At the planning stage, a Variational Autoencoder (VAE) learns a low-dimensional latent representation of the constraint manifold, enabling MPPI to efficiently generate near-feasible candidate trajectories without per-sample modification. Since this reference enables accurate linearization of the equality constraints, an execution-level Quadratic Programming (QP) controller resolves the residual manifold mismatch in a single solve rather than through iterative projection. Experiments on a 14-DoF closed-chain dual-arm system in both simulation and real-world settings demonstrate that MC-MPPI operates stably at 100 Hz, reliably navigates dynamic environments while effectively maintaining hard equality constraints, and significantly outperforms baseline methods in tracking accuracy. Supplementary videos and implementation details are available at https://rcilab.github.io/mcmppi.

</details>


### [444] [Learning Transferable Motor Skills for Geometry-Aware Robotic Surface Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24881)
*Miroslav David,Karla Stepanova,Robert Babuska*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种模块化框架，将几何运动规划与执行层面的专家技能解耦，通过可解释的原子化运动规则（如速度缩放和方向偏移）来修饰几何规划路径，并利用多模态神经网络从运动轨迹和CAD模型中学习规则参数，在L形和窗形物体的动态仿真中验证了速度与方向规则的有效提取。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人表面交互任务中，几何规划与精细执行难以兼顾：运动规划器缺乏人类操作员的精细技巧，而示教学习则过度依赖特定训练几何形状，泛化能力不足。

Method: 提出解耦框架：将专家行为建模为可解释的原子化运动规则（速度缩放、方向偏移等），这些规则系统性地修饰几何规划的参考路径；使用多模态神经网络从运动轨迹数据和CAD模型几何中联合推理规则参数。

Result: 在L形和窗形物体的动态仿真中，模型成功提取了速度缩放和方向偏移两种规则，并能在不同拓扑形状间迁移。

Conclusion: 该框架有效实现了几何规划与执行技巧的解耦，规则的可解释性和跨形状泛化能力是主要亮点，但在真实机器人上的验证仍是必要的后续工作。

Abstract: Robotic surface-interaction tasks, such as spray painting or welding, require both accurate geometric planning and precise motion execution. While modern motion planners generate valid geometric paths, they often lack the expert motor patterns observed in human operators. Conversely, learning from demonstration often tightly couples task execution to the specific training geometry, limiting transferability. We propose a modular framework that decouples geometric motion planning from execution-level expertise. Expert behavior is represented as a vocabulary of interpretable, atomic motor rules, such as velocity scaling and orientation offsets, that systematically modify a geometrically planned reference path. We train a multimodal neural network to infer rule parameters jointly from kinematic trajectory data and CAD model geometry. We evaluate our approach through dynamic simulation on L-shaped and window-shaped objects, demonstrating on simulated data that the model successfully extracts velocity and orientation rules across both topologies.

</details>


### [445] [MuJoCoUni:Persistent Batched Runtime Primitives for MuJoCo](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24922)
*Yufei Jia,Junzhe Wu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MuJoCoUni 是一个基于 MuJoCo 的下游扩展库，提供 BatchEnvPool 核心对象，支持在线机器人学习中的高吞吐并行环境执行，同时保留上游 CPU MuJoCo 的语义，通过 C++/pybind11 实现，可通过 pip install mujoco-uni 安装。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 MuJoCo 的 rollout 仅支持开环批量轨迹生成，缺乏在线机器人学习所需的状态化环境执行、高效并行重置、域随机化等运行时原语，因此需要 MuJoCoUni 来填补这一空白。

Method: 提出 BatchEnvPool 对象（C++/pybind11 实现），包含每个环境的 mjModel 副本、每线程的 mjData 工作线程和内部线程池；提供最终状态短步进、稀疏重置、重置生命周期域随机化、批量传感器前向评估（不推进动力学）、批量 Jacobian 和高度场查询等原语。

Result: 成功将实现约束在 Python 绑定层，不修改 MuJoCo 核心求解器、接触模型、积分器等源码；提供了验证和基准测试脚本，并作为开源包发布（pip install mujoco-uni）。

Conclusion: MuJoCoUni 以最小侵入方式扩展了 MuJoCo 生态，为在线机器人学习和批量物理评估提供了高吞吐、语义一致的并行环境执行能力。

Abstract: We present MuJoCoUni, a downstream MuJoCo distribution for online robot learning and batched physics evaluation. Alongside the open-loop batched trajectory generation already provided by upstream mujoco.rollout, MuJoCoUni supplies runtime primitives for stateful environment execution. The target workloads need high-throughput parallel execution while retaining upstream CPU MuJoCo semantics for models, sensors, contact, and constraints. Its core object, BatchEnvPool, is a C++/pybind11 executor that owns per-environment mjModel copies, per-thread mjData workers, and an internal thread pool. It provides final-state-only short stepping, sparse reset, reset-lifecycle domain randomization, batched sensor forward evaluation without advancing dynamics, and batched Jacobian and height-field queries. The implementation is confined to the Python binding layer; MuJoCo's solver, contact model, integrator, and core source tree retain upstream semantics. This report describes the BatchEnvPool API, implementation boundary, relationship to rollout, and the validation and benchmark scripts shipped with the open-source mujoco-uni package, which is installed with \texttt{pip install mujoco-uni}.

</details>


### [446] [Dynamic Neural Koopman Distillation for Real-Time Robot Control Using Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24924)
*Lei Zheng,Peiqi Yu,Zengqi Peng,Changliu Liu,Armin Lederer*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出Dynamic Neural Koopman Distillation框架，通过因子化动态Koopman层将扩散模型的多步去噪推理蒸馏为单步前向传播，在保持多模态表达能力的同时将推理延迟降至毫秒级，并在D4RL MuJoCo和真实Kinova机械臂上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型在机器人轨迹规划中能生成多样、多模态的轨迹，但其迭代去噪过程带来的延迟与高频闭环控制不兼容，需要一种既能保留多模态表达能力又能显著降低延迟的方法。

Method: 提出Factorized Dynamic Koopman层，通过因子化潜在状态转移和状态依赖模态增益来建模去噪过程，将多步扩散推理蒸馏为单步前向传播。

Result: 在D4RL MuJoCo迁移任务上显著优于现有的单步蒸馏方法，推理延迟降至毫秒级；在真实Kinova机械臂上实现了平滑快速的闭环执行，同时保持了任务成功率和可比精度。

Conclusion: Dynamic Neural Koopman Distillation方法有效解决了扩散模型在机器人闭环控制中的延迟问题，在合成环境和真实机器人上均展现了优异性能。

Abstract: Diffusion models excel at generating diverse and multimodal trajectories for robotic planning, yet their iterative denoising process introduces latency that is incompatible with high-frequency closed-loop control. To address this problem, we propose Dynamic Neural Koopman Distillation, a framework that distills multistep diffusion inference into a single forward pass while retaining the multimodal expressivity of the teacher model. Specifically, we introduce a Factorized Dynamic Koopman layer that models the denoising process through a factorized latent transition with state-dependent modal gains. We evaluate the proposed method on standard D4RL MuJoCo locomotion benchmarks and a physical Kinova manipulator, comparing against one-step baselines. The results show that our method significantly outperforms existing one-step distillation approaches on the reported locomotion tasks, and reduces the inference latency to the millisecond regime compared with the teacher policy. Hardware experiments further demonstrate that our method enables smooth and fast closed-loop execution while maintaining task success and comparable accuracy. A project page is available at https://fdkoopman.github.io/.

</details>


### [447] [Learning High-Frequency Continuous Action Chunks in Latent Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24931)
*Kunyun Wang,Yuhang Zheng,Yupeng Zheng,Jieru Zhao,Wenchao Ding*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出将高频动作学习从动作空间转移到VAE潜在空间，并结合Reuse-then-Refine块级精炼策略，实现高频（60Hz）下平滑且空间一致的机器人动作生成，在接触密集型任务中取得显著效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有动作分块策略在中频下表现良好，但进一步提升动作频率（如60Hz）时，生成的动作为满足时间平滑性和空间一致性。作者旨在解决高频控制中动作的时间平滑与空间一致性问题。

Method: 1) 使用变分自编码器（VAE）将高频动作学习从动作空间转移到潜在空间，提升时空一致性；2) 提出Reuse-then-Refine策略，在异步推理下对相邻动作块进行块级精炼，确保实时执行的平滑性。

Result: 在三个真实世界的接触密集型机器人任务上，该方法能够持续完成任务且动作平滑，减少了停顿和抖动。

Conclusion: 将高频动作学习转移到潜在空间结合块级精炼策略，能有效解决高频控制中的平滑性和一致性问题，在接触密集型任务中表现优异。

Abstract: Modern robotic policies increasingly rely on action chunking to execute complex tasks in the physical world. While action chunking improves temporal consistency at moderate action frequencies, it becomes insufficient when the action frequency is further increased (e.g., to 60~Hz). At such high frequencies, policies often fail to generate actions that are both temporally smooth and spatially consistent. We address this challenge by shifting high-frequency action learning from the action space to a latent space with variational autoencoder (VAE). This formulation significantly improves both temporal and spatial consistency of high-frequency control. To enable smooth real-time execution, we further introduce Reuse-then-Refine, a chunk-level refine strategy that improves continuity between adjacent action chunks under asynchronous inference. As a result, robots controlled by our policy can execute complex contact-rich tasks continuously, with less pauses and jerky motions. Experiments on three real-world contact-rich robotic tasks show that our approach consistently completes tasks with smooth motions. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/tars-robotics/RTR.

</details>


### [448] [HumanEgo: Zero-Shot Robot Learning from Minutes of Human Egocentric Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24934)
*Zhi,Wang,Botao He,Kelin Yu,Seungjae Lee,Ruohan Gao,Furong Huang,Yiannis Aloimonos*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: HumanEgo是一个无需机器人数据、可硬件无关、数据高效的框架，通过将人类第一人称视频中的手物交互提升为实体级表征，配合流匹配策略和密集辅助目标监督，实现零样本从人类演示到机器人的技能迁移。仅用30分钟人类视频即可达到92.5%的平均任务成功率。




<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类第一人称视频中蕴含着丰富的操作演示，但直接将这些技能迁移到机器人上存在明显的具身鸿沟（embodiment gap），包括视觉外观和运动学上的差异。现有方法往往需要机器人数据或大量人工标注，迁移效率低、泛化能力弱。

Method: 1) 将人类演示中的手-物交互提升为实体级（entity-level）表征，抽象掉人和机器人的具体外观差异；2) 采用流匹配（flow matching）策略策略生成动作轨迹；3) 设计密集辅助目标（dense auxiliary objectives），从每条轨迹中提取更多监督信号，提升数据利用效率。

Result: 在四个真实世界任务中，仅用30分钟人类视频平均成功率达92.5%（15分钟时75%）；比同等时间收集的机器人遥操作数据提升41%成功率；能零样本迁移到不同的机器人、摄像头和环境中。

Conclusion: HumanEgo成功证明了仅凭少量人类第一人称视频即可高效、鲁棒地实现跨具身（human-to-robot）的技能迁移，无需任何机器人专属数据，具备强泛化性和实用性。

Abstract: Human egocentric video captures rich manipulation demonstrations without any robot hardware, yet transferring these skills to robots remains challenging due to the embodiment gap between human and robot in both visual appearance and kinematics. We present HumanEgo, a framework that bridges the embodiment gap by lifting each human demonstration to an entity-level representation of hand-object interaction, and training a flow matching policy with dense auxiliary objectives that amplify supervision from every trajectory. HumanEgo is robot-data-free, hardware-agnostic, data-efficient, and zero-shot human-to-robot transferable. With only 30 minutes of human videos per task, HumanEgo achieves 92.5% average success across four real-world tasks (75% with just 15 minutes), outperforms matched-time robot teleoperation by 41%, and robustly transfers zero-shot across novel robots, cameras, and environments.

</details>


### [449] [ARCANE-PedSynth: Synthetic Multi-Pedestrian Datasets with Behavioural Crossing Annotations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24950)
*Muhammad Naveed Riaz,Maciej Wielgosz,Antonio M. López Peña*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了ARCANE-PedSynth，一个基于CARLA的开源框架，用于生成合成多行人数据集，解决CARLA原生穿越率低（9%）的问题，通过混合AI-人工控制架构将穿越率提升至75%，并生成带密集行为标注的RGB、LiDAR和DVS多模态数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动驾驶中的行人穿越预测需要大量带行为标注的数据，但真实数据获取成本高且标注困难。现有CARLA模拟器原生行人穿越率仅9%，无法满足训练需求，因此需要一种能生成高穿越率、多样化行为且带密集标注的合成数据框架。

Method: 提出混合AI-人工行人控制架构，结合12状态行为有限状态机和5种角色原型，实现可配置的穿越率（最高75%）；框架可同步生成RGB、LiDAR、DVS多模态数据，并自动标注每帧穿越标签、行为状态和2D姿态关键点；通过CLI参数化和Docker容器化确保可复现性。

Result: 生成了PedSynth++示例数据集，包含533个多行人片段，覆盖12种天气条件，提供RGB、LiDAR和DVS三种数据流。

Conclusion: ARCANE-PedSynth有效解决了合成行人数据中穿越率低和行为多样性不足的问题，为自动驾驶行人预测研究提供了可复现、高标注质量的多模态数据生成工具。

Abstract: We present ARCANE-PedSynth, an open-source CARLA-based software framework for generating synthetic multi-pedestrian datasets with dense behavioural annotations for pedestrian crossing prediction in autonomous driving. The framework overcomes CARLA's native 9% crossing rate through a hybrid AI-manual pedestrian control architecture, enabling configurable target rates up to 75%. A 12-state behavioural finite state machine with five character archetypes produces diverse crossing behaviours. The framework generates synchronised RGB, LiDAR, and DVS data with per-frame crossing labels, behavioural states, and estimated 2D pose keypoints. We demonstrate ARCANE-PedSynth through PedSynth++, an example dataset generated with the framework, comprising 533 multi-pedestrian clips across 12 weather conditions with RGB, LiDAR, and DVS streams. ARCANE-PedSynth is fully reproducible via CLI parameterisation and Docker containerisation.

</details>


### [450] [Bridging the Gap: Enabling Soft Actor Critic for High Performance Legged Locomotion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24975)
*Gianluca Sabatini,Chenhao Li,Marco Hutter*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文发现SAC在批量并行训练中性能不如PPO的原因，并提出针对性改进（策略初始化、超时感知的评论家目标、多步回报估计），使SAC在腿式机器人运动任务上完全追上PPO的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PPO虽在腿式机器人训练中表现优异，但其on-policy性质导致样本效率低，不适合真实硬件上的持续微调；而off-policy的SAC天然适用于sim-to-real迁移，却一直无法在批量并行训练中匹敌PPO的性能。

Method: 识别SAC在大规模并行训练中表现不佳的根本原因，并引入三项针对性改进：策略初始化、超时感知的评论家目标（timeout-aware critic targets）、多步回报估计（multi-step return estimation）。

Result: 在多种腿式机器人平台和多样化运动任务上的评估表明，改进后的SAC完全消除了与PPO的性能差距。

Conclusion: 通过针对性改进，SAC能够在保持off-policy样本效率优势的同时，在批量并行训练中达到与PPO同等的性能水平。

Abstract: Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) has become the de facto standard for training legged robots, thanks to its robustness and scalability in massively parallel simulation environments like IsaacLab. However, its on-policy nature makes it inherently sample-inefficient, preventing its use for continuous adaptation and fine-tuning on real hardware. Soft Actor-Critic (SAC), by contrast, is an off-policy algorithm that can reuse past experience, making it a natural candidate for sim-to-real transfer workflows where the same algorithm can be used both in simulation and for online learning on the real robot. Despite these advantages, SAC has consistently failed to match PPO's empirical performance in massively parallel training settings. This work identifies the root causes of this gap and introduces targeted modifications, covering policy initialization, timeout-aware critic targets, and multi-step return estimation, that enable SAC to train stably at scale. Evaluated across multiple legged robot platforms and diverse locomotion tasks, our approach closes the performance gap with PPO entirely.

</details>


### [451] [Loosely Coupled Factor Graph Optimization for Pseudolite-Augmented Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24980)
*Chih-Chun Chen,Lipeng Tan,Shiyu Bai,Heike Vallery*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种松耦合因子图优化框架，融合GNSS/伪卫星最小二乘解与IMU数据，在GNSS降级环境中将三维定位误差降低22.8%-41.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在GNSS降级环境中，伪卫星可提供额外信号源增强定位性能，但它们在基于优化的框架中的集成仍然有限。

Method: 提出松耦合因子图优化（FGO）框架，融合GNSS/PL最小二乘解与IMU数据，在低GNSS可见性场景（4颗高仰角卫星+最多2个PL发射器）下进行评估。

Result: FGO相比标准最小二乘法将三维平均误差降低22.8%-41.3%；相比GNSS-IMU基线，加入PL发射器可进一步提升定位精度。

Conclusion: FGO框架能有效融合伪卫星与GNSS/IMU数据提升定位性能，且性能受几何构型影响。

Abstract: In Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS)-degraded environments, pseudolites (PLs) provide additional signal sources to enhance positioning performance, but their integration in optimization-based frameworks remains limited. This paper presents a loosely coupled factor graph optimization (FGO) framework that fuses the GNSS/PL least-squares (LS) solutions with inertial measurement unit (IMU) data. The evaluation considers low GNSS visibility scenarios with four high-elevation GNSS satellites and up to two PL transmitters over an 80~s window. FGO achieves a 22.8\% to 41.3\% reduction in mean 3D error compared to standard LS methods. Compared to a GNSS-IMU baseline, incorporating PL transmitters further improves positioning accuracy, with performance depending on geometry.

</details>


### [452] [Learning, locomotion, and navigation of soft synthetic snakes in three-dimensional, heterogeneous environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24985)
*Xiaotian Zhang,Ali Albazroun,Tixian Wang,Songyuan Cui,Prashant G. Mehta,Mattia Gazzola*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于生物启发的计算框架，通过强化学习训练软体蛇形机器人在非结构化三维地形中自主导航，在真实环境重建的高保真仿真中验证了其鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无肢陆地动物（如蛇）具有卓越的 locomotor 灵活性和控制能力，远超当前工程机器人。因此，作者希望弥合生物系统与软体机器人之间的差距，让合成软蛇也能在复杂、异构的三维地形中自如导航。

Method: ① 建立生物启发的驱动与感知模型，降低高自由度连续体的控制复杂度；② 将这些模型整合到强化学习架构中，推导出环境穿越策略；③ 先在简化均质地形中训练，学习基础运动基元；④ 再将基元组合成适应复杂地形的策略；⑤ 在高保真三维环境中（基于真实世界影像重建）部署验证。

Result: 成功实现了软体蛇形机器人在高保真3D环境中的可靠导航，证明了所提框架的鲁棒性和实用性。

Conclusion: 本研究提供了一个物理真实的仿真平台，并为连续体系统在自然地形中的控制提供了实践洞见，有助于推动软体机器人在真实复杂环境中的应用。

Abstract: Limbless terrestrial animals exhibit exceptional locomotor versatility and control, currently unmatched by engineered counterparts. Here, we introduce a computational framework that enables soft synthetic snakes to navigate unstructured, heterogeneous 3D terrains. Our approach is grounded in bio-inspired actuation and sensing models that reduce the control complexity inherent to high-degree-of-freedom, continuum bodies. These models are integrated into a reinforcement learning architecture to derive environment-traversing policies. Training first occurs in simplified, homogeneous terrains to learn locomotion primitives. These are then composed into adaptive strategies for complex landscapes. We demonstrate robustness by deploying a snake in high-fidelity 3D environments reconstructed from real-world imaging, achieving reliable navigation. Overall, this work provides a physically-realistic simulation platform and practical insights for the control of continuum systems in natural terrains.

</details>


### [453] [Stiffness Optimization for Concentrated Bending in Magnetically Actuated Catheters: Maintaining Steerability under Gradient Stiffness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25005)
*Jiewen Tan,Junnan Xue,Shing Shin Cheng,Shuang Song,Erli Lyu,Jiaole Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种刚度优化的多段磁驱动软导管（SO-MAC），通过解耦转向-推进机制和梯度刚度架构，解决了磁驱动软导管在高效推进与近端集中弯曲之间的权衡问题。实验显示该1.5mm直径导管可在10mm尖端实现180°转向（3mm弯曲半径），并在支气管模型中成功验证了导航性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 磁驱动软导管存在根本性矛盾：高轴向/弯曲刚度有利于推力传递但降低可转向性，低刚度虽能实现大角度近端弯曲却易在压缩推进时发生扭结/屈曲。现有设计难以同时满足高效推进与灵活转向的需求。

Method: 提出SO-MAC设计：(1) 解耦的转向-推进机构，使转向与推进功能独立；(2) 梯度刚度架构，近端刚度低以集中弯曲，远端刚度高以传递推力；(3) 弹簧骨架的弹性回复机制抵抗摩擦引起的扭结/屈曲。

Result: 在0-180°的联合转向推进中，支点保持稳定，远端尖端近乎直线地朝向目标方向前进。1.5mm直径SO-MAC在10mm尖端实现180°转向（3mm弯曲半径），平均形状误差1.39±0.56mm，转向支点误差0.35±0.10mm。在支气管模型中通过视觉反馈控制成功实现复杂弯曲分叉路径导航。

Conclusion: SO-MAC通过刚度优化设计有效平衡了推进效率与转向灵活性，梯度刚度架构和弹簧骨架的弹性回复机制解决了传统软导管在压缩推进下的扭结问题，在微创介入手术中具有应用潜力。

Abstract: Achieving both efficient pushability (propulsion transmission) and proximally concentrated bending for steerability is challenging for magnetically actuated soft catheters: higher axial/bending stiffness improves force transmission but reduces steerability, whereas lower stiffness enables large, proximally concentrated bending yet increases kinking/buckling risk under compressive push loads. To address this trade-off, we propose a stiffness-optimized multi-segment magnetically actuated catheter (SO-MAC) that integrates a decoupled steering-advancement mechanism with a gradient-stiffness architecture. The SO-MAC concentrates bending about a stable proximal pivot during advancement while the distal section passively self-straightens to transmit propulsion, aided by the optimized stiffness distribution and elastic recovery of the spring backbone against friction-induced kinking/buckling. Over $0{-}180^{\circ}$ combined steering and advancement, the pivot remained stable and the distal tip advanced near-straight toward the target direction. A 1.5 mm-diameter SO-MAC achieved up to $180^{\circ}$ steering with a 3 mm bending radius at its 10 mm tip, with an average shape error of $1.39 \pm 0.56$ mm and a steering-pivot error of $0.35 \pm 0.10$ mm. Visual feedback control in a bronchial phantom further confirmed robust navigation through highly curved, bifurcating paths.

</details>


### [454] [Convex-Neural RRT*: Fast and Reliable Learning-Guided Sampling for High-Quality Robot Path Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25006)
*Hichem Cheriet,Badra Khellat Kihel,Samira Chouraqui,Bara J. Emran*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 Convex-Neural RRT* 算法，通过神经网络预测高质量路径附近的凸候选区域来引导采样，在保持全局探索的同时聚焦几何相关区域。在18个基准地图上相比基线方法计算时间降低30-98%，路径长度平均缩短约5%，成功率保持在99%以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于采样的路径规划算法虽具概率完备性，但实践中需要大量迭代才能获得高质量解，计算效率亟待提升。

Method: 利用神经网络预测高质量路径附近的候选区域，从中提取凸区域引导RRT*采样，在局部聚焦和全局探索之间取得平衡。

Result: 相比神经引导变体计算时间降低30-75%，相比LTA*降低88-98%；路径长度平均减少约5%，复杂环境下提升更显著；成功率超过99%。

Conclusion: 凸引导神经采样方法有效平衡了计算效率与解质量，适用于对时间敏感的机器人导航任务。

Abstract: Sampling-based algorithms for robot path planning offer probabilistic completeness and strong empirical convergence properties across environments with diverse obstacle configurations. However, in practice, these methods often require many iterations to obtain high-quality solutions. This paper proposes Convex-Neural RRT*, an enhanced RRT* variant that incorporates neural guidance to predict informative waypoint regions near high-quality paths. Convex candidate regions are extracted from these predictions, enabling the planner to concentrate exploration on geometrically relevant areas while preserving global exploration. The proposed algorithm is evaluated against Neural RRT*, Neural Informed RRT*, classical RRT*, and LTA* across three environment types and 18 benchmark maps. Experimental results show that Convex-Neural RRT* reduces computation time by 30-75% compared to neural-guided variants and up to 88-98% relative to LTA*, while achieving an average path length reduction of approximately 5% compared to classical RRT*, with larger improvements observed in complex environments. The method also maintains an overall success rate above 99% across varying obstacle densities. These findings indicate that convex-guided neural sampling provides an effective balance between computational efficiency and solution quality, supporting its applicability to time-sensitive robotic navigation tasks.

</details>


### [455] [Performance Comparison of Classical and Neural Sampling Algorithms for Robotic Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25010)
*Hichem Cheriet,Badra Khellat Kihel,Samira Chouraqui*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文实现了RRT*、Neural RRT*和Neural Informed RRT*三种算法，在含凸/凹障碍物的不同密度环境中进行测试。结果表明，神经引导规划器相比传统RRT*可缩短14%路径长度并提升55-75%轨迹平滑度，其中Neural Informed RRT*综合表现最佳，验证了AI引导采样策略在机器人/UAV导航中的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将人工智能集成到基于采样的运动规划中，以提升自主导航效率，解决传统RRT*在路径质量和轨迹平滑度方面的不足。

Method: 在包含凸/凹障碍物、不同障碍密度的环境中，实现并对比评估RRT*、Neural RRT*和Neural Informed RRT*三种算法。

Result: 神经引导规划器产生缩短14%的路径和55-75%更平滑的轨迹；Neural Informed RRT*在路径长度和轨迹平滑度上综合表现最佳；计算时间略有增加。

Conclusion: AI引导的采样策略能有效提升机器人/UAV导航的可靠性和轨迹效率，表明人工智能在实时机器人路径规划中日益重要。

Abstract: Integrating artificial intelligence (AI) into sampling-based motion planning provides new possibilities for improving autonomous navigation efficiency. In this paper, three algorithms, namely RRT*, Neural RRT*, and Neural Informed RRT*, are implemented and evaluated on environments containing convex and concave obstacles with different obstacle densities. The obtained results indicate that neural-guided planners improve path quality, producing up to 14\% shorter paths and 55--75\% smoother trajectories compared with the conventional RRT* algorithm. Among the evaluated methods, Neural Informed RRT* achieves the best overall performance in terms of path length and trajectory smoothness. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of AI-guided sampling strategies for improving reliability and trajectory efficiency in robotic and UAV navigation, despite a slight increase in computation time. Overall, the study highlights the growing importance of artificial intelligence in real-time robotic path planning applications.

</details>


### [456] [Micro-Swarm Locomotion Optimization in Dynamic Flow using Multi-Objective Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25025)
*Josef Berman,Oren Gal*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一种混合CFD与多目标多智能体强化学习框架，在脉动血流环境中协调16个微型磁驱机器人，通过PCGrad解决梯度冲突，实现了上游推进、能效和平滑性的多目标优化，并发现了三种涌现行为阶段。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生理性真实、时间依赖流体环境中的微型机器人群体协调控制仍未解决，传统方法难以处理流体-智能体时变交互的复杂性。

Method: 将高保真不可压缩Navier-Stokes求解器与去中心化近端策略优化(PPO)直接耦合，并采用PCGrad（梯度手术）化解多目标间的梯度冲突。

Result: 收敛策略达到推进奖励6.5-7.0、能效0.63-0.65、平滑度0.97-0.99；无PCGrad时能效和平滑度在10,000步内崩溃。

Conclusion: 时变流体-智能体交互可直接纳入多目标强化学习循环，为生物医学导航、环境监测等领域的微型群体控制提供了物理可行的新范式。

Abstract: Coordinating micro-robotic swarms in physiologically realistic, time-dependent fluid environments remains an unsolved challenge for biomedical and environmental applications. We present a hybrid Computational Fluid Dynamics - Multi-Objective Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning framework that directly couples a high-fidelity incompressible Navier-Stokes solver with decentralized proximal policy optimization to learn physically consistent swarm control strategies in oscillatory flow. Sixteen magnetically actuated micro-robots navigate a pulsatile arterial waveform, simultaneously optimizing upstream progression, energy conservation, and motion smoothness, reconciled using PCGrad surgery. Without PCGrad, energy efficiency and smoothness rewards collapse to near zero within 10,000 training steps while progress exhibits persistent large-amplitude oscillations, confirming that gradient conflict resolution is a structural requirement rather than an optional refinement in this domain.
